summary: The shared category data path is sound, but the new overflow rail has layout and accessibility failures, and the market-list redesign introduces loading, analytics, and E2E regressions. The PR body and inherited recipe also target UI that this branch removed.

comments.body: `row.clientWidth` is the reduced flex width after More has mounted. That makes fitting history-dependent: after a shrink, growing back to a width that fits all pills can still retain More, and a long promoted active pill can fit the full row but produce `fitted = 0` once More consumes space, hiding the active filter and its clear action. Measure a stable outer-rail budget and the More trigger separately, guarantee the active item remains visible, and add shrink→grow plus long-label tests.

This signature contains category IDs only, so a locale change does not invalidate widths despite the comment above. Hidden overflow items are unmounted and keep their old cached width indefinitely; a shorter translation can therefore stay unnecessarily under More. Include rendered labels or an explicit locale/measurement version in the signature and remeasure all items when it changes.

Choosing an option from More changes the selected category's position in `keysSignature`. This render-time reset temporarily renders every item, empties `overflowCategories`, and unmounts the More trigger that Dropdown just focused; when More remounts, focus is left on the document body. Preserve the trigger during remeasurement or explicitly focus the promoted active pill after layout, with a keyboard test that selects an overflow option.

This More Dropdown creates a nested `role="listbox"` with neither `aria-label` nor `aria-labelledby`. The outer rail group's label does not provide an accessible name for the nested widget. Extend Dropdown to link the listbox to its trigger (or accept a menu label) and assert it with a named `getByRole('listbox')` query.

`right-0` assumes LTR. In an RTL locale the flex row places More at the left edge, so this minimum-120px menu extends beyond the viewport. Use logical inline-end positioning or explicit LTR/RTL variants so the menu opens inward in both directions.

While market data is initially loading, `displayedMarkets` is empty and this renders `0 markets` beside loading skeletons, which is a false settled value. A one-result filter also renders `1 markets`. Hide or skeleton-gate the count until loading settles and use singular/plural messages.

The normal search path now clicks this toggle and lands in an auto-focused input, so `SearchInput.onInputClick` does not fire and `SEARCH_CLICKED` is no longer recorded. Track the closed→open transition here and remove or deduplicate the input-click path.

Making the search input conditional breaks `PerpsMarketListPage.fillSearch()`, which still waits for `search-input` without opening this toggle; its only caller is skipped, so CI does not expose the timeout. Update the page object to click `market-list-search-toggle` first and cover it with an active E2E test.

This only searches for a directly rendered pill. At popup width later categories such as commodity and forex are unmounted under More, so `selectFilter()` waits forever despite documenting support for them. If the pill is absent, open `market-list-categories-more-button` and select its option; type `optionId` as `MarketFilter` and exercise the overflow path.
